3: Plan exact binding, arguments and backend scope

5: Ask branch: local exact review within original deadline; deny/timeout means no dispatch
6: Ask branch: approve exact local challenge or deny within original deadline
7: Approve exact challenge or return structured denial; continue only if approved
8: Pin compatible binding and coherent types
9: Recheck current document and contract pins
10: Fail-closed mandatory admission audit before dispatch
11: Return exact Admission and policy/contract pins
12: Dispatch Admission once; no replay of uncertain effects
14: Record admitted dispatch and observed/unknown outcome
15: Return bounded invocation result or structured denial/unknown outcome
16: Return single final JSON-RPC result/error; POST SSE normally terminates
